_comment: Interstate '76 static memory map. Generated/verified 2026-07-18 via tools/exe-xref.py + exe-disasm.py against the GOG binaries. 1997 PE, no ASLR -> loads at preferred base 0x400000 under Wine; these VAs are live process addresses. Confidence: 'confirmed' = read straight from disassembly; 'struct' = offset within a dynamically-allocated struct (needs the runtime base pointer); 'runtime' = not yet located, pin with the trainer scanner.

input_state_block.note: base of the live per-action input value block (0x536770..0x536818)

cam_yaw.note: live camera Euler; head-tracking write target

ffb_present_flag.note: 1 only if i7_SFRCE.DLL loaded + 3 exports + InitSystem>=0 at boot (one shot, no retry). NO registry gate in Gold. See docs/FFB-DEEP-DIVE.md

ffb_event_heap.note: CORRECTED 2026-07-19: HeapCreate(0,0,0) handle for impact-event nodes, NOT an FFB object ptr

ffb_force_block.note: force-state block filled EVERY sim tick by ffb_tick 0x445ba0 when flag=1; full field map in docs/FFB-DEEP-DIVE.md; ffb-shim/ consumes it for pad rumble

music_active_flag.note: nonzero = music playing (read to know when music should play)

entity_group_counts.note: Tier 4 entity table: alive count per faction/team group

entity_group_arrays.note: stride 0x100 per group; entry = wrapper handle (see entity_table)

mp_player_table.note: DirectPlay MULTIPLAYER player table: 16 records x 0x48, player id WORD @+0, vehicle ptr @+0x28. All zeros in single-player - a named dead end for the SP car, kept for future MP work.

component_array.note: each: type-tag at +0; health/condition offset = runtime-scan

vehicle._correction: These offsets are NOT flat on the transform-entity (reading them there returns garbage) - they belong to the logic-object side reached via entity+0x108/+0x10c. The earlier '0x144-stride sub-struct' reading (STATIC-RE-FABLE section 9) was a hex/decimal mixup: live dissection shows component records at stride 0x90 (=144 DECIMAL). For ammo/part-condition use pointer_chains.inventory_table below - it supersedes the weapon-object route for the trainer. Current truth: docs/MEMORY-MAP-INDEX.md.

fields.+0x08: world transform (rotation matrix; position offset NOT yet pinned)
fields.+0x108: ptr -> vehicle-LOGIC object (engine accessor 0x466e20; aggression path)
fields.+0x10c: ptr -> logic/sub-object dissected for the 0x90-stride component records (chaindiff walks this)

player_entity.note: +0x108 vs +0x10c: two threads each called theirs 'the logic object'; may be one graph or two adjacent sub-objects - unreconciled, see MEMORY-MAP-INDEX open item 4

inventory_table.conf: live-verified twice (incl. across relocation); tools/i76-rearm.ahk field-tested
inventory_table.layout: 17 records x 0x38: +0x00 int 7 (header - validate!), +0x04 ptr 0x00750000, +0x08 int CURRENT (ammo/condition), +0x0c int MAX
inventory_table.note: Every weapon's ammo AND every part's condition. Fallback: sweep entity-0x1500..entity-0x1000 for the (7, 0x00750000) signature. Values are plain int32; part/armor values are integer TENTHS.

vehicle_logic.conf: live-walked (weapon count 4 at +0xa718; +0xa71c did NOT hold heap ptrs - offset or object mismatch)
vehicle_logic.note: 16 component records @ stride 0x90 from ~+0x40 were dissected on the +0x10c object (+0x40 int dur 100, +0xac float 100.0, +0xc4 = 50). AI aggression = logic+0xa818 (int 0..4). Field meanings unpinned.

armor_candidates.note: Large per-panel damage grids; DEFENSE panel is likely a rollup. To lock: note on-screen DEFENSE values, take one hit, re-read. Float scans and literal 910 scans were dead ends.

entity_table.note: entity(g,s)=[0x507da0+g*0x100+s*4] = wrapper; wrapper->[.]->+0x70->+0x108=logic; AI aggression=logic+0xa818. Enumerate all 8 groups for radar/targeting.

nitro.exe.md5_note: GOG Nitro Pack nitro.exe (same engine, shifted addresses)
nitro.exe.note: Camera/input struct layout identical to Gold; other Gold offsets (component list, weapon arrays, FFB) transfer by shape - re-anchor exact VAs with tools/exe-xref.py nitro.exe when needed.
